purpose: Teach: 断ら/就い/傘下/綿密/総論/凝らし/辛抱/リストアップ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 依頼を断られた場合の代替案を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's have a backup plan ready in case our request gets turned down.
lines.style: Light, forward-leaning suggestion; gentle energy on the proposal, careful not to sound bossy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新部署のリーダー就任、つまり就いた社員の研修を整えます
lines.en: Right. I'll arrange training for the employee who's taken up the new department's leadership role.
lines.style: Easy agreement with a warm half-smile; unhurried, confident he's got it handled.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 傘下の地方法人と連携しましょう
lines.en: Let's coordinate with the regional subsidiaries under our umbrella.
lines.style: Brighter, quicker proposal; small encouraging lift at the end inviting his buy-in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトの計画を綿密に組みます
lines.en: Right. I'll put the project plan together meticulously.
lines.style: Relaxed and assured; slows on 'meticulously' as if already picturing the schedule.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内報の総論セクションを刷新しましょう
lines.en: Let's give the overview section of the company newsletter a fresh update.
lines.style: Thoughtful pitch, slightly tentative opening that firms up as the idea takes shape.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告に工夫を凝らした表現を入れます
lines.en: Right. I'll work some inventive touches into the advertising copy.
lines.style: Wry, pleased delivery; a playful lean on 'inventive' like he's teasing a secret plan.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員の辛抱強さを評価制度に反映しましょう
lines.en: Let's get employees' perseverance reflected in the evaluation system.
lines.style: Softer, sincere suggestion; gentle emphasis on 'perseverance', real warmth for the staff behind it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今四半期の重点案件をリストアップします
lines.en: Right. I'll draw up a list of this quarter's priority projects.
lines.style: Brisk closing confirmation; light energy, the sound of someone already reaching for their notebook.
